CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.KOL_EksportKnt(@TS INT,@RozmiarPaczki int,@NumerPaczki int,@OpeNumer int) AS BEGIN TRAN
DECLARE @WierszOd int DECLARE @WierszDo int
SET @WierszOD = @RozmiarPaczki * @NumerPAczki + 1 SET @WierszDo = @RozmiarPAczki * (@NumerPaczki+1)
CREATE TABLE #TmpTable (GIDNumerO int not null, Typ int not null, Akronim varchar(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Nazwa1 varchar(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, KodP varchar(10) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Miasto varchar(30) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Ulica varchar(30) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Adres varchar(30) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, NipE varchar(13) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS not null, Knt_LastModC int not null, LP int identity not null)
INSERT INTO #TmpTable (GIDNumerO,Typ,Akronim,Nazwa1,KodP,Miasto,Ulica,Adres,NipE,Knt_LastModC) SELECT Knt_GIDNumer, isnull(Knt_Typ,0), isnull(Knt_Akronim,''), isnull(Knt_Nazwa1,''), isnull(Knt_KodP,''), isnull(Knt_Miasto,''), isnull(Knt_Ulica,''), isnull(Knt_Adres,''), isnull(Knt_NipE,0), Knt_LastModC FROM CDN.KntKarty WHERE Knt_Aktywna=0 AND Knt_LastModC > @TS AND KNT_ARCHIWALNY<>1
SELECT GIDNumerO,Typ,Akronim,Nazwa1,KodP,Miasto,Ulica,Adres,NipE,Knt_LastModC, LP FROM #TmpTable WHERE LP Between @WierszOD AND @WierszDo ORDER BY LP
DROP TABLE #TmpTable
COMMIT TRAN
